test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 13 Oct 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate word to fill in the blank.**

The Blood Finder app is very useful in _______ the correct donor.
solution:
The correct answer is **'locating'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The first clause of the sentence is in the present tense so **locating **is the present continuous f
